description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs", spans from 1e7 to 9e8 on a logarithmic scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of one order of magnitude. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)", ranges from 94 to 100. The plot contains five lines: a purple line with triangle markers representing "Vanilla"; an orange line with circle markers representing "SepLLM (n=64)"; a blue line with cross markers representing "SepLLM (n=128)"; a green line with diamond markers representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)"; and a red line with circle markers representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)". The "Vanilla" line remains nearly constant at approximately 100%. The "SepLLM (n=64)" line starts at approximately 98.3% and rises to a peak of about 100% near 4e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The "SepLLM (n=128)" line begins at approximately 97% and increases steadily to a peak of about 100% near 6e8 TFLOPs before declining slightly. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line starts at approximately 97.4% and rises to a peak of about 100% near 6e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line begins at 94% and rises to approximately 99% before leveling off near 99%.
